clusters.headline: Listyo Sigit Prabowo Skips Ethics Hearing Over Wiretapping Claims
aiSummaryBullets: The Police Ethics Commission postponed the disciplinary hearing for Listyo Sigit Prabowo until next week.
The former police chief declined to attend the session concerning accusations related to the illegal wiretapping of the president.

clusters.headline: MPR Sets Four Day Grace Period For Vice President Candidates Data
aiSummaryBullets: The MPR verification team is granting candidates a four-day window to fulfill any outstanding administrative requirements.
Verification involves cross-referencing candidate documentation with institutions including the Supreme Court, the KPK, the Ministry of Finance, and Mabes Polri.

clusters.headline: Prabowo and Polri Dismantle International Drug Trafficking Rings
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto and National Police Chief Suyudi Ario Seto presided over the destruction of 601.7 tons of seized narcotics.
The National Police reported over 73,000 suspects arrested in connection with more than 56,000 narcotics cases throughout the past year.

clusters.headline: Persib Bandung Beats FC Seoul 3-1 To Secure AFC Champions League 2
aiSummaryBullets: Persib Bandung defeated FC Seoul 3-1 at Gelora Bandung Lautan Api Stadium.
The victory confirmed Persib Bandung as the winner of Group E in the AFC Champions League Two.

clusters.headline: RSPAD Submits Health Test Results Of Andi Amran And Sugiono To MPR
aiSummaryBullets: Andi Amran Sulaiman and Sugiono completed a series of health evaluations conducted by RSPAD Gatot Soebroto for vice presidential candidacy.
Both candidates reported no physical complaints or issues following the completion of fourteen specific medical testing stages.

clusters.headline: House Commission X Urges CPNS Certainty For Teachers Over Age 35
aiSummaryBullets: House Commission X is demanding clarity on technical guidelines for teacher recruitment for candidates exceeding the 35-year age limit.
Regional governments, including Majalengka and East Kalimantan, are transitioning part-time PPPK teachers to full-time status starting in 2027.

clusters.headline: Thirteen Dead and Thirteen Missing at Illegal Gold Mine in Bogor
aiSummaryBullets: Search and rescue teams have recovered 13 bodies from an illegal gold mining site located in the Ciguha area of Pongkor, Nanggung, Bogor.
Authorities confirm that 13 additional miners remain trapped or missing, while rescue efforts persist despite facing significant operational challenges.

clusters.headline: NasDem, Golkar, And PAN Formally Support Sugiono For Vice President
aiSummaryBullets: NasDem, Golkar, and PAN have formally declared their support for Sugiono to serve as Vice President for the 2024-2029 term.
The coalition seeks to elect a successor to the vice presidency through an open vote during an upcoming People's Consultative Assembly session.

clusters.headline: Former MPR Secretary General Ma'ruf Cahyono Faces Corruption Trial
aiSummaryBullets: Former MPR Secretary General Ma'ruf Cahyono stands trial for allegedly receiving gratifications totaling Rp 30.91 billion.
The prosecution has announced plans to present 40 witnesses during the ongoing legal proceedings.

clusters.headline: Prabowo Praises Police Chief Suyudi Amidst Mining Revenue Reform
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto commended Police Chief Suyudi Ario Seto for significant anti-narcotics efforts and institutional integrity.
The government is actively pursuing a policy to secure 70 percent of national mining revenues to support state development goals.

clusters.headline: Kapolri Jenderal Suyudi Commits To Eradicating Drug Trafficking
aiSummaryBullets: Kapolri Jenderal Suyudi Ario Seto labeled narcotics as the mother of all crimes during a briefing.
The Chief of Police stated that drugs pose the greatest threat to Indonesia's youth in reaching the 2045 national vision.

clusters.headline: President Prabowo Subianto Applauds Police Progress On Key Reforms
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto praised the current police leadership for reducing social media influence campaigns and improving food safety programs.
The President highlighted successful police operations, including the dismantling of a large-scale clandestine laboratory for narcotics production.

clusters.headline: DVI Teams Identify Remains Following Massive Fire At PT FAM Cikande
aiSummaryBullets: Police forensic teams are accelerating DNA testing to identify remains recovered from the site of the factory fire.
Search efforts for dozens of missing individuals have been hindered by unstable building structures and adverse weather conditions.

clusters.headline: Prabowo Expands Sekolah Rakyat Program To Combat National Poverty
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo aims to establish 500 Sekolah Rakyat units as a strategic effort to break the cycle of poverty through education.
The Ministry of Social Affairs and the Ministry of Development and Creative Economy have signed an MoU to integrate adolescent counseling into the program.

clusters.headline: Kupang Regent Yosef Lede Named Suspect In Alleged Rape Case
aiSummaryBullets: Polda NTT has formally declared Kupang Regent Yosef Lede a suspect in the sexual assault case involving a 21-year-old university student.
The regent has been placed in police detention and faces potential charges carrying a maximum sentence of 12 years in prison.

clusters.headline: BNPB Urges Residents in Aceh to Prepare for Peak Rainy Season
aiSummaryBullets: BNPB issued a warning for residents in Aceh to heighten vigilance during the peak of the rainy season.
The Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources is increasing fuel stocks to ensure availability during extreme weather events.

clusters.headline: US Weighs Targeting Iranian Leaders Amid Ongoing Regional Conflict
aiSummaryBullets: The Trump administration is debating whether to target senior Iranian leaders in an effort to end the ongoing regional conflict.
Iranian officials deny developing chemical weapons, alleging that Israel is attempting to manipulate the US into further military engagement.

clusters.headline: OECD Projects Indonesia Fiscal Deficit To Reach 2.9 Percent In 2026
aiSummaryBullets: The OECD projects that Indonesia's budget deficit will expand to 2.9 percent of GDP by 2026.
The House of Representatives and Bank Indonesia have agreed upon a 2027 operational budget of Rp37.79 trillion.

clusters.headline: Expansion of Kopdes Merah Putih and Kampung Nelayan Initiatives
aiSummaryBullets: State electricity firm PLN plans to collaborate with Kopdes Merah Putih on a 100 gigawatt solar power project.
The government is scaling up the Kampung Nelayan Merah Putih program with new locations in East Kalimantan and Donggala.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Provinces Finalize 2027 Minimum Wage Adjustments
aiSummaryBullets: Regional authorities across Indonesia are finalizing 2027 provincial and regency minimum wage levels amid varying economic conditions.
Central government officials are urging provinces like Central Papua and Highland Papua to promptly establish their 2027 wage standards.
